In the context of a hypothetical, write the jacket blurb for a thriller where a modern day operative of the FBI, ends up back in the early 1960's having to use her knowledge of "future" forensics to leave clues to enable her modern colleagues to catch a time-hopping serial-killer, before he dies.assistant
response:
"When FBI operative Rachel Jenkins is sent back in time to the early 1960s, she finds herself in the midst of a decades-old mystery. A serial killer, known only as 'The Timekeeper,' has been terrorizing the nation, leaving a trail of bodies in his wake. But this is no ordinary killer - he's a time-hopper, able to move through the ages with impunity.

As Rachel navigates the unfamiliar landscape of 1960s America, she must use her knowledge of future forensics to leave clues that will aid her modern colleagues in catching The Timekeeper. But with each passing day, she realizes that she's not just fighting a killer - she's fighting against the very fabric of time itself.

With the help of a local detective, Jack Harris, Rachel must use her skills to unravel the mystery of The Timekeeper's true identity and motivations. But as the body count rises, Rachel begins to suspect that The Timekeeper may not be the only one who knows the secrets of the past.

As the clock ticks down, Rachel must use all her knowledge of future forensics to leave a trail of breadcrumbs that will lead her modern colleagues to The Timekeeper's lair. But with only 13 days left before The Timekeeper dies, Rachel must act fast - or risk losing the chance to bring him to justice.

Will Rachel be able to solve the mystery of The Timekeeper before it's too late? Or will she become the next victim of his time-hopping reign of terror? Find out in this gripping thriller, where the past and present collide in a deadly game of cat and mouse."
